logger.doc:name: Log validation failed
logger.message: #["[" ++ correlationId ++ "] validation failed fields=" ++ ((vars.errorDetails map ((d) -> d.field)) joinBy ",")]

logger.doc:name: Log not found
logger.message: #["[" ++ correlationId ++ "] customer not found customerId=" ++ vars.customerId]

logger.doc:name: Log rate limited
logger.message: #["[" ++ correlationId ++ "] backend rate limited customerId=" ++ vars.customerId]

logger.doc:name: Log backend error
logger.message: #["[" ++ correlationId ++ "] backend error type=" ++ error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier]

logger.doc:name: Log unexpected error
logger.message: #["[" ++ correlationId ++ "] unexpected error type=" ++ error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier]
